State is a key-value store per agent, for coordination: an agent writes its
progress or results, others read them.

State is stored in this host's database, and belongs to an agent record:
only agents spawned here have state, and cleanup deletes it. Keys starting
with "_" are written by status reports; e.g. "_result" holds a Claude
agent's latest reply (empty while a turn is running).

Usage:
  agent state [flags]
  agent state [command]

Examples:
  agent state set helper progress "3/5 files done"
  agent state get helper _result

Available Commands:
  set         Set a state entry for an agent
  get         Print a state value
  list        List all state entries for an agent
  clear       Remove an agent's state entries, or one key

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for state

Global Flags:
      --backend string          Backend for spawn or adopt: claude, aider, agy, or shell (spawn requires it or --backend-config; adopt auto-detects)
      --backend-config string   JSON file defining a custom backend (or app settings); pass it again to status/wait/watch for agents spawned with it
  -q, --quiet                   Don't print hints (results and errors still print)
      --termd-ns string         g3d-termd namespace (default: agents; never default or wall)

Use "agent state [command] --help" for more information about a command.
